summary: Full backend + frontend testing of NHL Backtest Martingale module on BetsTracker. Created /app/backend/tests/test_nhl_backtest.py (13 pytest cases) - ALL PASS. Frontend Playwright flow verified: login → /backtest → seasons populate desc → season change updates teams (32) + range + start_date → filter → toggle 4 teams (5th disabled) → run backtest → KPIs/per-team cards/sparkline/tables render → 'Mostra tutte' expands. Reference run (Boston/Colorado/Edmonton/NYR, 2023-2024 from 2023-10-10, cap=8) reproduced exactly: P&L €353.70 / 328 bets / 45.4% WR / 0 bust / max stake €128.

minor.issue: max_consecutive_losses validation accepts values < 0; treated as 'unlimited' implicitly. Behavior is documented in code comment ('0 or negative = unlimited') but no Pydantic ge=0 constraint. Cosmetic.
Returns {min:null,max:null} (200) for unknown season instead of 404. Fine for current frontend usage.

issues: Stagione uses native browser <select> styled minimally (consistent with the rest of the app's lightweight UI components, not shadcn). Acceptable.
Uses browser-default date picker (input type=date). Same convention as AddBet form noted in iteration_1. Acceptable per product decision.

action_items: Optional: add Pydantic constraint `max_consecutive_losses: int = Field(default=8, ge=0)` to NHLBacktestReq for input hardening.

Optional: when changing season on the form, briefly disable the 'Esegui backtest' button while teams/season-range API calls are in-flight to prevent users from running a backtest with stale start_date (UI race window <1s). Not observed under normal use.
No blocking issues. Feature is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _run_team_backtest is well-structured but ~130 lines inline; could be extracted to /app/backend/services/nhl_backtest.py if the module grows.
server.py is now ~700 lines; reaching the recommended split threshold. Consider splitting into routers (auth, strategies, bets, bonuses, nhl) when next feature is added.

/api/backtest/nhl loads ALL games for the selected teams in memory (max ~328 docs for 4 teams/season -> negligible). Fine for current scope; if expanded to many teams or seasons, paginate or aggregate in MongoDB.

Frontend NHLBacktest.js: useEffect on [season] resets selected teams but does not abort an in-flight Promise.all from a previous season change (potential stale write). Low impact given fast network; consider AbortController or a sequence ID guard if users rapidly change seasons.

Profit/win rules confirmed in code AND verified by tests: favorite -> AH-1.5 win iff !is_draw_regulation && score_diff>=2; underdog -> ML win iff team_score>opp_score; martingale double on loss, reset on win, bust on cap with progression reset. All consistent with spec.
seed_data_creation: None. NHL games seeded by main agent (6560 games / 5 seasons). No data created/modified during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: NHL backtest tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_nhl_backtest.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_nhl_backtest.py -v`. Reference verified output: 4 teams/2023-2024/2023-10-10/cap=8 -> aggregate.total_profit=353.70, total_bets=328, win_rate≈0.454, total_busts=0. Frontend data-testids: bt-season, bt-start-date, bt-stake, bt-bankroll, bt-cap, bt-filter-teams, bt-team-{Team-Name-with-dashes}, bt-run-btn, bt-kpi-{pnl|final|roi|yield|wr|bets|staked|bust}. Cap=2 produces busts (validated). Note: /api/nhl/* and /api/backtest/nhl all require Bearer auth (verified 401 without token).
rca of the issue: No critical issues. Initial frontend test had a timing race (1500ms wait too short between season select and start_date update) — fixed by polling wait_for_function on the start_date value; functionally the UI updates correctly.
